purpose: M12/T9 F-197 (R5-E09-03) / H3 - the per-family skip expectation. CI printed green while whole families of tests were skipped: the SQL statement gate and every WSL-dependent control never executed, and the job's conclusion was SUCCESS. AGENTS.md section 11 requires an unavailable required gate to stay NOT RUN; here it was folded into "fail 0". The owner's answer is to SET AN EXPECTATION, and the measurement says it must be a PER-FAMILY expectation: one global number would fire on ~40 legitimate host-capability skips.
runner: the CI quality-gate job (ubuntu-24.04). The numbers below are that runner's expectations; the gate enforces them where it runs on CI, and on any other host it enforces only the fail-closed half (an unexplained skip) and reports the counts.
note: The families are CAPABILITIES, never test names. A lane declares the family it belongs to with a `// SKIP-FAMILY: <id>` marker, so the family-to-lane map is DERIVED from the repository's own lane list and this table never becomes a second, hand-written copy of the test names. An expectation changes only in the same commit that explains why.

families.reason: the live WSL runtime root is not reachable on the CI runner, so the cases that compare the repository against the live build report NOT RUN instead of a pass
the operator's backup of the live runtime is not reachable on the CI runner, so the native-lineage cases that read it report NOT RUN instead of a pass
the production ledger is not reachable on the CI runner, so the cases that read it report NOT RUN instead of a pass
the retired runtime-root copy of the live channel is not reachable on the CI runner, so the lineage case that reads it reports NOT RUN instead of a pass
the live extension tree is not mountable on the CI runner, so the reachability case that reads it reports NOT RUN instead of a pass

the R16 apply rehearsal runs only inside the private mount namespace the rehearsal driver creates, and the CI runner has no WSL mount namespace, so the rehearsal cases report NOT RUN instead of a pass
these cases refuse a symlinked path, and the CI runner can create symlinks, so the family must execute there; a skip means the case stopped protecting the refusal
the SQL statement gate needs the PostgreSQL container, and the CI runner has no Docker daemon, so its three cases report NOT RUN instead of a pass
the Docker contract lanes need a Docker daemon, and the CI runner has none, so their cases report NOT RUN instead of a pass
